ITAView Support

ITAView is an image viewer for Mac with 24 interface languages. It requires macOS 13 or later and is built for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. The app processes images locally and does not require an account.

Open and browse images

Open a folder to browse its images. Use the arrow keys to move between images. Enter an image number to jump to that image.

If you opened one image, choose its containing folder to browse other images in that folder. macOS grants access to the files or folders that you select. Opening one image alone does not grant access to every neighboring file.

View controls and formats

Fit the image to the window or view it at its actual size. Use a two-finger pinch to zoom. Switch to full screen when you need more viewing space.

ITAView reads JPEG, PNG, HEIC, and other image formats supported by macOS. Animated images and other multi-frame images display their first frame only. Image editing and browsing inside archives are not included. ITAView does not modify the original images.

Report a problem

The Privacy Policy and Support links in the Help menu open your default web browser. The viewer itself makes no network requests. Website visits and email messages are external actions that you choose. Opening a link does not automatically send the images you view.

Send support and privacy requests to the public contact. Include your Mac model, macOS version, ITAView version and build, image format, and steps that reproduce the issue. Describe the result you expected and the result you saw. If you need to attach a sample, use an image without private content.

ITAView is an independent app and is not affiliated with Honeyview. The app does not upload images or send telemetry. Email that you send to support is separate from the app's local operation.
